finalists.label: Phototoxic Maculopathy
finalists.why: It has specific findings such as hyperreflective area at external retinal layers and disruption of ellipsoid zone that are not shared with its rivals.

finalists.label: Phototoxicity
finalists.why: It has specific findings such as best corrected visual acuity and hyperreflective area at external retinal layers that are not shared with its rivals.

frontier_selector.why: The evidence of hyperreflective area at external retinal layers, disruption of ellipsoid zone, and mild eminence of retinal pigment epithelium at fovea decided the final comparison in favor of Phototoxic Maculopathy.
